children: Polymarket Developers said the Protocol V2 release date has been moved from November 2 to November 9 to avoid the week of the U.S. midterm elections. According to Odaily, the final schedule and deployment plan, including specific timing and the order of market migrations, will be announced in the coming days; users do not need to take any action in the meantime.

title: Polymarket Protocol V2 Release Moved to November 9 to Avoid U.S. Midterm Election Week
